description: Read the recent posts of one public profile: the text, likes, replies, reposts, quotes, the post URL and when it was published. Threads, Bluesky and Mastodon. Boosts and reposts of other people are filtered out — you get what the account itself wrote, its replies included. `limit` is optional on Bluesky and Mastodon, and each has its own range: a value outside it is rejected rather than silently trimmed. Threads does not accept `limit` at all and answers 400 if you send it — its posts arrive inside the same document as the profile, so there is no upstream to ask for a count. Requires an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` — free key at https://honesthook.com/docs#key; costs 1 credit.

handle.description: The account handle, without the leading @. On Mastodon it must be `user@instance`, because the same local name exists on many servers.

limit.description: How many posts to return. Optional, and Bluesky and Mastodon only. The valid range depends on the platform and the API rejects a value outside it instead of trimming it, so the count you get is never quietly smaller than the count you asked for. Threads answers 400 if you send this at all: its posts come from the profile document, not from a query you can size.

platform.description: Which platform to read the posts from.

name: fetch_posts
title: Fetch recent posts
